info.description: Purple call-to-action strip with an optional heading, optional description, a required primary CTA, and an optional secondary CTA

primaryButtonLink.description: Internal links must start with a leading slash (e.g. /grant/our-grantmaking). External links must be a full URL starting with http:// or https://. mailto:, tel:, and #anchor links are also supported.

secondaryButtonLink.description: Internal links must start with a leading slash (e.g. /grant/our-grantmaking). External links must be a full URL starting with http:// or https://. mailto:, tel:, and #anchor links are also supported.
